en.html:
In the end, I could not accept. The killing around the Silver Star had already brought me to my limit.

Fight and kill for Yamato's future? That much capacity I did not have. The prince had helped me greatly; disappointing him hurt. But hurt or not, what could I do?

Fortunately, neither he nor the Chief tried to order me. They did not even insist on my silence—as if that needed saying. A silent nod, and they let me leave.

So this was not my doing. Absolutely not. I need not have held a full inspection of my memories to establish that. Someone else had brought Moriuji Ashikaga to his death.

If it was not natural death. If an assassin's hand was involved...

Then Prince Maidono's shadow behind it was difficult not to suspect.

But who had served as the blade in my place? On the prince's side, was there anybody capable of killing Moriuji Ashikaga?

No name came to mind...

ja.html:
結局、俺は引き受けることができなかった。
　銀星号に<ruby>纏<rt>まつ</rt></ruby>わる殺戮だけで限界だった。

　大和の未来の為に戦い殺すなど、俺の器量を超えて
いた。
　恩ある親王の期待に背くのは心苦しい。だが仕様も
ない。

　幸い、親王も署長も強いて命じようとはしなかった。
　念を押して口止めするようなこともなく――そんな
のは当たり前だ――無言で頷いたきり、俺が退出する
に任せてくれた。

　だから、俺の仕業ではない。断じて。わざわざ記憶
を反芻して確認するまでもない事だが。
　足利護氏を死に至らしめた者は別にいる。

　自然死ではなく、刺客の手が存在したなら……
　
　やはりその奥に、舞殿宮の影を疑わずにはおれない。

　しかし、誰が俺に代わって刃の役を務め上げたのか。
　誰か……いただろうか？　親王の側に、足利護氏を
仕留め得るような者が。

　心当たりはないが……。

Prince Maidono"Aah... finally, some peace. My shoulders had become one solid complaint."
Chief"You have had a tiring time, Highness."
Prince Maidono"You also, na. Still, Kenchouji... As far as sitting under the Ashikaga nose goes, not much has changed."
Chief"Better, at least, than being kept indefinitely inside Fudaraku Castle... I would say."
Prince Maidono"True... Chalo, leave that."
Prince Maidono"Straight to the main matter. ...What do you think?"
Chief"..."

舞殿宮「そらね……。 　まぁ、そんなこたええわ」
舞殿宮「早速本題やけど。 　……どう思う？」
署長「……」
